 Shiyu /Photo=Shiyu SNS Shiyu, the former girlfriend of singer and actor Kim Hyun-jung, drew attention by bringing up her son during a live broadcast on the same day it was revealed that she is active on TikTok.
 On the 22nd, news emerged that Shiyu is working as a creator under the TikTok live agency "Lightning Central."
 Shiyu has opened a TikTok account and is conducting live broadcasts. It is reported that she plans to expand her activities into various fields such as beauty, health, and entertainment in the future.
 On the day this news was released, Shiyu said during her TikTok live broadcast, "I received so many messages today that I couldn't even eat." She then shared updates on her son, stating, "I have a child to take care of every morning, so I lead a busy life."
 Shiyu also did not miss the chance to boast about her son. She stated, "My son is growing up so solidly that he is always elected as class president or vice-president at school." She added, "He excels academically and has an outstanding appearance, making him very popular. When you ask me like this, I can't help but brag about my child."
 Some have pointed out that while mentioning the fact that her son is an illegitimate child could be delicate, Shiyu continued to boast about her son starting from the day her activity news was revealed. Concerns have also been raised that the child may be exposed, as specific details about his school life and appearance have been disclosed.
 Kim Hyun-jung / Photo = StarNews Shiyu is Kim Hyun-jung's former girlfriend, with whom she dated for approximately three years starting in 2012. A legal dispute began in 2014 when Shiyu filed a complaint against Kim Hyun-jung on charges of assault and injury. At the time, it was reported that Kim Hyun-jung expressed his official apology and privately paid Shiyu a settlement of 600 million won, after which the two reconciled.
 However, conflicts resurfaced. In 2015, Shiyu claimed she suffered damages such as miscarriage and abortion due to Kim Hyun-jung's assault and filed a lawsuit seeking approximately 1.6 billion won in compensation. Kim Hyun-jung also filed a counterclaim and sued Shiyu on charges of extortion, fraud, false accusation, and defamation.
 The legal battle extended to civil and criminal trials. In 2016, the first-instance civil court ruled that Shiyu had damaged Kim Hyun-jung's reputation through interviews and ordered her to pay 100 million won in damages. The same judgment was issued on appeal, and the verdict became final in 2020 when the Supreme Court dismissed appeals from both sides.
 In the criminal trial, Shiyu received a partial guilty verdict regarding the charge of attempted fraud. However, it was judged that her claim of miscarriage due to Kim Hyun-jung's assault could not be clearly deemed false, and she was definitively found not guilty of the charge of defamation through publications.
 Amid this, Shiyu gave birth to Kim Hyun-jung's son in September 2015. Although suspicions arose regarding paternity, it was later confirmed that Kim Hyun-jung was the biological father, and Shiyu has been raising her son.
 Meanwhile, Kim Hyun-jung married a non-celebrity woman in 2022 and had a son in the same year.
